sources.title: Our Journey（Euronext官网）

founded_year.quote: 2000 The start: the first pan-European exchange, Euronext, is born Merger of the Amsterdam, Brussels and Paris exchanges to create Euronext N.V., the first pan-European exchange.

history.zh: 2000年阿姆斯特丹/布鲁塞尔/巴黎三所合并成立Euronext（首个泛欧交易所）；2001年收购LIFFE衍生品交易所并首次IPO（巴黎/阿姆斯特丹/布鲁塞尔三地同时挂牌）；2002年并入葡萄牙里斯本-波尔图交易所（成为Euronext Lisbon）；2007年与纽约证券交易所对等合并成NYSE Euronext；2013年ICE收购NYSE Euronext；2014年ICE保留LIFFE、将大陆欧洲业务拆分重新IPO为独立的Euronext N.V.（此后集团历史续接现在的法人实体）；2017年推出自有交易平台Optiq；2018年收购爱尔兰证券交易所（成为Euronext Dublin）；2019年收购Oslo Børs VPS（挪威交易所+挪威中央证券存管机构）；2020年收购丹麦中央证券存管机构VP Securities；2021年完成收购Borsa Italiana集团（米兰并入，同时成立跨国CSD网络Euronext Securities）；2023-2024年清算业务分阶段从LCH SA迁移至集团自有CCP Euronext Clearing（现货2023年11月、衍生品2024年9月完成）；2025年宣布并完成对希腊雅典交易所（ATHEX）的换股收购（成为第八个市场，但尚未并入统一规则手册与Optiq平台，计划2027年6月完成技术迁移）；同年9月Euronext N.V.自身股票纳入法国CAC 40指数
history.en: 2000: merger of Amsterdam, Brussels and Paris exchanges forms Euronext (first pan-European exchange). 2001: acquires LIFFE and completes first IPO (listed simultaneously in Paris/Amsterdam/Brussels). 2002: merges with the Portuguese exchange (becomes Euronext Lisbon). 2007: merger of equals with NYSE, forming NYSE Euronext. 2013: ICE acquires NYSE Euronext. 2014: ICE keeps LIFFE and spins off the continental European operations as a newly independent, re-IPO'd Euronext N.V. (the group's history continues under this legal entity). 2017: launches proprietary trading platform Optiq. 2018: acquires the Irish Stock Exchange (becomes Euronext Dublin). 2019: acquires Oslo Børs VPS (Norwegian exchange + Norwegian CSD). 2020: acquires VP Securities, the Danish CSD. 2021: completes acquisition of the Borsa Italiana Group (Milan joins; the cross-border CSD network Euronext Securities is launched). 2023-2024: clearing migrates in phases from LCH SA to the Group's own CCP, Euronext Clearing (cash markets November 2023, derivatives markets September 2024). 2025: announces and completes a share-exchange acquisition of the Athens Stock Exchange (ATHEX), becoming the eighth market — not yet integrated into the harmonised rulebook or Optiq, migration targeted for June 2027; in the same year (September 2025) Euronext N.V.'s own share joins the French CAC 40 Index

regulator.en: No single regulator — each of the seven Market Undertakings is supervised by, and governed under the law of, its own jurisdiction: Euronext Amsterdam (Netherlands, AFM/DNB), Euronext Brussels (Belgium, FSMA/BNB), Euronext Paris (France, AMF), Euronext Dublin (Ireland, Central Bank of Ireland), Euronext Lisbon (Portugal, CMVM), Borsa Italiana (Italy, CONSOB), Oslo Børs (Norway, Finanstilsynet); regulators in six countries have established a coordination mechanism for cross-market supervisory matters. This is the most fundamental structural difference from every single-jurisdiction exchange sampled so far in this project

core_laws.en: No single core law — each of the seven Market Undertakings operates under its own country's national implementation of MiFID II (the EU Markets in Financial Instruments Directive): the Netherlands' Financial Supervision Act (Wet op het financieel toezicht) Article 5:26, Belgium's Law of 21 November 2017 on market infrastructures, France's Monetary and Financial Code Article L.421-2, Portugal's Decree-Law 357-C/2007, etc.; MiFID II/MiFIR is the shared EU-level legislative basis behind each national law

opening_mechanism.zh: 开盘集合竞价（Opening uncrossing）：订单累积期内只录入订单不成交，撮合算法启动时中央订单簿短暂冻结，以能实现最大成交量的理论开盘价定价；若无法撮合，则以主交易时段第一笔成交价作为开盘价
opening_mechanism.en: Opening uncrossing: during the order-accumulation period orders are entered but not matched; when the matching algorithm runs the Central Order Book is briefly frozen and the opening price is set at the level that maximises matched volume; if no match occurs, the price of the first trade in the main trading session becomes the opening price

sources.title: Notice n°4-01 Trading Manual

opening_mechanism.quote: At the opening, the Euronext Trading Platform seeks to match orders for each Security (the "opening uncrossing"). At the beginning of the price determination phase for a Security the Central Order Book is frozen momentarily ... while the matching algorithm is running. The opening price is the last theoretical opening price calculated before matching.

closing_mechanism.zh: 收盘集合竞价（Closing uncrossing）：机制与开盘集合竞价相同；收盘参考价通常即收盘集合竞价成交价，若集合竞价未产生成交价则退而采用主交易时段最后成交价
closing_mechanism.en: Closing uncrossing: the same mechanism as the opening uncrossing; the closing reference price is generally the closing-uncrossing price, falling back to the last traded price of the main session if the uncrossing produces no price

sources.title: Notice n°4-01 Trading Manual

closing_mechanism.quote: Except for certain Securities where the closing reference price results from alternative methods described in Article 5.4, the closing reference price for Securities which are traded continuously shall in general be the price defined by the closing uncrossing. If no price is issued at the closing uncrossing, the closing reference price shall in general be the last traded price during the main trading session.

matching_principle.zh: 严格价格优先，同价位按时间优先（strict price/time priority）；对未公开披露的订单类型（大宗订单Large-in-Scale、中间价订单Mid-Point）另有独立的规模/时间优先规则
matching_principle.en: Strict price priority, with strict time priority at the same price level; orders exempted from pre-trade transparency (Large-in-Scale orders, Mid-Point orders) follow separate size/time priority rules

sources.title: Euronext Rule Book Book I - Harmonised Rules（Rule 4401/1）

matching_principle.quote: Orders in the Central Order Book shall be executed according to strict price priority. Orders at the same price are ranked and executed according to strict time priority

order_types.zh: 市价单（Market）、限价单（Limit）、止损单（Stop）、冰山单（Iceberg）、中间价单（Mid-Point/Primary Peg）、最小成交量单、仅参与集合竞价的VFU/VFCU订单、拍卖量发现单（Auction Volume Discovery, AVD）等，具体适用哪些类型按交易分组（trading group）而异
order_types.en: Market, Limit, Stop, Iceberg, Mid-Point/Primary Peg, Minimum-quantity, auction-only VFU/VFCU orders, Auction Volume Discovery (AVD) orders, etc.; the specific set of order types available varies by trading group

type.zh: 双层价格区间机制——动态区间（dynamic collar，基准价为逐笔更新的最新成交价）+ 静态区间（static collar，基准价为当日开盘价或前日收盘参考价），触及阈值即触发预约期（reservation period），不是直接拒单的固定百分比涨跌停
type.en: Two-layer price-range mechanism — dynamic collars (reference price updated after each trade) plus static collars (reference price is the day's opening price or the previous day's closing reference price); breaching a threshold triggers a reservation period rather than flatly rejecting orders as with a fixed daily limit

sources.title: Trading safeguards on the Euronext markets

type.quote: Dynamic and static collars constitute the first and second layers of Euronext's circuit-breaker mechanism, respectively. The dynamic reference price and the static reference price are used to calculate both collars. The dynamic reference price changes throughout the trading day after each trade, with the last traded price becoming the new reference. The static reference price remains the same during all trading sessions unless it is manually changed by Euronext's Market Operations team.

main_board.zh: 动态区间：普通股±5%，旗舰指数成分股±3%；静态区间：普通股±10%（对照前收盘价），旗舰指数成分股±8%——「旗舰指数」按fee guide定义为CAC 40/AEX/BEL 20/PSI/SBF 120/AMX/ISEQ 20/OBX/FTSE MIB成分股
main_board.en: Dynamic collars: ±5% for ordinary shares, ±3% for flagship-index constituents; static collars: ±10% (vs previous close) for ordinary shares, ±8% for flagship-index constituents — "flagship index" per the fee guide covers constituents of CAC 40/AEX/BEL 20/PSI/SBF 120/AMX/ISEQ 20/OBX/FTSE MIB

sources.title: Trading safeguards on the Euronext markets

main_board.quote: Dynamic collars are based on the dynamic reference price ... This safeguard threshold automatically halts trading on a stock if its price reaches +/−5% price variation (or +/-3% if the stock is part of a flagship index) on the dynamic collar reference price. Static collars are based on the static reference price ... This safeguard threshold automatically halts trading on a stock if its price reaches +/−10% price variation (or +/-8% if the stock is part of a flagship index) on the static collar reference price.

other_boards.zh: Euronext Growth/Access板块及衍生品市场另有各自的静态/动态区间参数（衍生品市场机制与Eurex类似，另设Dynamic Collar Reference Price/DCRP与Static Collar Reference Price/SCRP），具体数值本次未逐一核实
other_boards.en: Euronext Growth/Access segments and the derivatives markets carry their own static/dynamic collar parameters (the derivatives-market mechanism resembles Eurex's, with its own Dynamic/Static Collar Reference Price — DCRP/SCRP); exact values not individually verified this session

circuit_breaker.zh: 无独立于价格区间机制之外的全市场级熔断；动态/静态区间（见price_limits）本身是个股级机制，触发后进入预约期（reservation period），未见覆盖全市场所有品种的指数级熔断安排
circuit_breaker.en: No market-wide circuit breaker separate from the price-collar mechanism; the dynamic/static collars (see price_limits) are themselves a stock-level mechanism that triggers a reservation period upon breach — no index-level, market-wide halt covering all instruments was found
circuit_breaker.detail: 与Eurex（同样只找到个股/合约级机制、未发现独立的全市场级熔断）情况类似，可能是本次检索范围局限，未逐条核实是否存在，见OPEN-QUESTIONS。

volatility_interruption.zh: 预约期（reservation period）：连续交易阶段理论撮合价触及适用阈值即触发预约期，至少持续3分钟；因动态区间触发的首次预约后，恢复交易有两种方式——由Euronext评估市场情况后人工设定参数，或按预约期内报价自动更新动态区间后自动撮合恢复；若自动方式仍在同方向再次触发预约，是否进一步调整区间/参考价须再经Euronext评估市场情况后决定
volatility_interruption.en: Reservation period: triggered when the theoretical matching price during continuous trading breaches the applicable thresholds, lasting at least 3 minutes; upon the first reservation caused by a dynamic collar breach, resumption may follow either a manual process (parameters set by Euronext after assessing market conditions) or an automatic process with updated dynamic collars; if the automatic process is breached again in the same direction, any further adjustment to the collars or reference price is decided by Euronext only after a fresh market assessment

sources.title: Notice n°4-01 Trading Manual

volatility_interruption.quote: Euronext initiates a reservation period if, during the continuous trading phase, the theoretical price at which a security can be traded breaches the applicable thresholds. The reservation period shall last at least 3 minutes. ... Upon the first reservation caused by dynamic collars breach, the attempt to resume trading may take place following two possible processes depending on the type of securities: - Manual process with parameters determined by Euronext after an assessment of market conditions; - Automatic process with updated dynamic collars using the interval for uncrossing process mentioned in the Appendix. If upon this first trading resumption attempt, the updated collars are breached in the same direction (i.e. second consecutive downwards or second consecutive upwards reservation), any decision to adjust the collars and the reference price before resuming continuous trading will be made after an assessment of market conditions.

trading_halt_mechanism.zh: 见volatility_interruption；另有针对单一异常订单/异常事件的独立停牌能力，具体触发条件与恢复流程本次未逐条核实
trading_halt_mechanism.en: See volatility_interruption; a separate capacity to halt an instrument in response to a single disruptive order or unusual event also exists, exact trigger conditions and resumption process not individually verified this session

trading_halt_mechanism.quote: the capacity to halt instruments subject to single orders that might disrupt the market

dark_pool.en: Non-pre-trade-transparent (dark) trading exists — Large-in-Scale orders and Mid-Point orders match in a dedicated non-displayed order book, executed on a size/time priority basis

dark_pool.quote: Mid-Point Orders shall only interact between each other in a dedicated non-displayed order book and are executed according to size/time priority.

market_maker_scheme.zh: 存在多类流动性提供者安排（统称Liquidity Provider），含针对ETF的做市商计划、针对结构性产品的做市商义务，以及「零售流动性厂商」（Retail Liquidity Firm）——后者的报价仅能与零售订单撮合，享有同价位优先权；具体各计划的量化义务（点差、报价时长占比）本次未逐一核实
market_maker_scheme.en: Multiple categories of liquidity provider exist (collectively "Liquidity Providers"), including ETF market-maker programmes, Structured Product market-maker obligations, and "Retail Liquidity Firms" — whose quotes can only match Retail Orders and are given precedence at the same price level; the quantitative obligations of each programme (spread, quoting-time coverage) were not individually verified this session

sources.title: Euronext Rule Book Book I - Harmonised Rules（Retail Liquidity Firm Quotes条款）

market_maker_scheme.quote: at identical price, Retail Liquidity Firm Quotes have precedence to match with Retail Orders.

connect_schemes.zh: 本所自身即是「一个交易所横跨多国市场」的互联互通式结构（七个市场共享同一中央订单簿/同一交易平台Optiq），与其他交易所之间是否另有独立的跨境互联互通安排（如与LSE、Nasdaq等的对接）本次未核实
connect_schemes.en: The exchange itself already embodies a "one exchange spanning multiple countries" connected structure (seven markets share one Central Order Book / one Optiq trading platform); whether separate cross-border connect schemes exist with other exchanges (e.g. LSE, Nasdaq) was not verified this session

settlement_cycle.quote: The new T+1 model shortens the EU securities settlement cycle, which is currently set to T+2. Under the new model, the settlement of securities transactions ... is completed on the business day immediately following the trade date (T+1). The go-live for the transition to T+1 is scheduled for 11 October 2027.

membership_structure.zh: 统一的「Euronext Membership」资格体系：申请人须向拟加入的具体市场运营实体（Relevant Euronext Market Undertaking）申请并获书面批准，资质要求含本国监管机构授权/牌照、员工须具备英语或所在法域语言的业务能力、充足的组织与资源安排等；会籍不可转让；自然人与独资企业不得成为Euronext证券市场会员

financial_transaction_tax.detail: 法国、意大利均对本国上市大市值公司股票交易开征金融交易税（法国FTT、意大利Tobin Tax式规则），荷兰/比利时/爱尔兰/葡萄牙/挪威税制安排各异；这是「一所多国」结构下税费类字段的典型难点——单一字段无法承接七国不同税制，本次未逐国核实具体税率与征收对象，留空不代入。

capital_gains_tax.detail: 同financial_transaction_tax，七国资本利得税制各异，单一字段无法承接，留空。

fx_risk_note.zh: 六个欧元区市场（阿姆斯特丹/布鲁塞尔/都柏林/里斯本/巴黎/米兰）无资本管制，欧元自由浮动；奥斯陆市场以非欧元的挪威克朗（NOK）计价结算，是本所内部唯一存在真实汇率敞口的市场，交易该市场证券对欧元区投资者构成汇率风险，其余六个市场之间无汇率风险
fx_risk_note.en: The six euro-area markets (Amsterdam, Brussels, Dublin, Lisbon, Paris, Milan) have no capital controls and the euro floats freely; the Oslo market is priced and settled in Norwegian Krone (NOK), the only market within the group carrying genuine FX exposure — trading its securities poses FX risk to euro-area investors, while no FX risk exists among the other six markets
fx_risk_note.detail: 属结构性推论（基于各国法定货币这一基础事实），非交易所自设规则，未附强quote。

regulatory_change_risk_note.zh: 正处于两项欧盟层面重大制度变革窗口期：（1）结算周期T+2→T+1（2027-10-11生效，见clearing.settlement_cycle）；（2）2025年新纳入的雅典市场尚未整合进统一规则手册与Optiq平台（计划2027-06完成），整合完成前雅典与其余七个市场在规则细节上仍不完全一致
regulatory_change_risk_note.en: Currently in a window of two major EU-level structural changes: (1) the settlement cycle move from T+2 to T+1 (effective 11 October 2027, see clearing.settlement_cycle); (2) the newly-added Athens market (2025) has not yet been integrated into the harmonised rulebook or Optiq (integration targeted for June 2027) — until completion, Athens' detailed rules remain not fully aligned with the other seven markets

sources.title: Euronext Regulated Markets（Euronext官网）

regulatory_change_risk_note.quote: Euronext Athens markets are scheduled to be integrated in the Euronext rulebooks upon the migration to Optiq (June 2027).
